title: Expression tree checkpoint
prompt: Implement `static Expression<Func<int, bool>> BuildPredicate(int threshold)` returning an expression equivalent to `x => x >= threshold && x % 2 == 0` (built programmatically, capturing threshold). Then implement `static string Describe(Expression<Func<int, bool>> e)` that returns the expression's NodeType of its body (e.g. "AndAlso").

tests.name: built-predicate
tests.hint: Expression.Parameter(typeof(int), "x"), then GreaterThanOrEqual, Modulo, Equal, AndAlso; wrap in Lambda<Func<int,bool>>.
